summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence bug  ### What I found from reading the code (no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` schema, plus the session/cookie flow in `db/auth.ts` and `modules/auth/handlers.ts`.  Everything I read is actually wired correctly: - Every watchlist row requires a `user_id` (`NOT NULL`, no guest/default fallback) and every read/write handler filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. - `userId` comes from the session cookie (`arca_session`)
